The stamp lands on the remedy row at 40.2 s and leaves 'Under development' at 40.4 s. story_review.one_viewing_summary: A driverless SUV picks up at a San Antonio airport curb. A map shows the small first service area. Two empty cars end up in floodwater, each disclosed as a separate example. A federal recall card counts nearly 3,800 cars. An illustration of the recall sentence shows a car slowing, then rolling into standing water. The remedy row is stamped under development, and weather limits plus an April 20 update reach the fleet. The film closes on the open airport ride beside that remedy row.
story_review.opening_to_ending: It opens on an airport ride anyone can hail and ends on that same kind of ride held beside a remedy still under development. The ending answers the opening question, and per-scene disclosures prevent the illustrations being read as the actual recalled cars.
story_review.weakest_transition: s1 to s2 at 7.0 s. The planned bridge of a car pin riding from the curb onto the map is not visible. A hard cut lands on a nearly blank map that holds static until 7.8 s.
